name: Construction-Computing Education Map (Europe + South America)
description: Dataset of higher-education institutions offering programmes in digital construction, BIM, and construction informatics, with programme, cost, accreditation, delivery, and geographic detail. Europe (309) plus a Chile pilot for South America (21).
citation: European Construction-Computing Education Map (v1.0.0). CC BY 4.0. <add author / DOI on deposit>.

sourcesOfRecord.note: Primary per-record sources are the institution homepage (`website`) and the programme pages (`programLinks`). No third-party aggregator is treated as authoritative.

coordinates.method: Geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim, then a precision-audit pass that re-queried city-centroid fallbacks with a 25 km distance gate, plus manual verification of unresolved cases. Per-record method recorded in `geoSource`.

geoSourceLegend.nominatim:name+city: resolved to the named institution in its city (campus-level)
geoSourceLegend.nominatim:name: resolved to the named institution (institution-level)
geoSourceLegend.nominatim:name (audited): upgraded from city centroid during the audit pass (campus-level)
geoSourceLegend.nominatim:city: city centroid only — approximate, not the campus location

graduatesPerYear.nature: Values are annual-graduate estimates, expressed as ranges. They are indicative, not official institutional statistics.
graduatesPerYear.imputation: Records originally lacking a figure were imputed from the median of peer institutions in this dataset (same country and institution type where n>=3, widening to type, then to all). Imputed records carry `graduatesEstimated: true` and a `graduatesEstimateBasis` string.

cost.unit: indicative tuition in each record's costCurrency (EUR/year for Europe; CLP total-programme for Chile).
cost.note: Europe: 307 numeric, 2 'Variable' (funding-dependent). Chile pilot: 5 records carry a published figure; 16 are null placeholders because the institution gates the fee behind an enquiry form (to be completed manually). 'Variable' is not used for Chile.

legend.1: recently collected, not yet validated against sources
legend.2: cross-referenced with publicly available university sources

topics.note: The topics field uses a controlled vocabulary split into two facets: computingTopics (the digital subject matter) and domains (built-environment context). Each record carries computingTopics and domains as derived subsets of topics.

tagging.rule: Tag a topic only where the institution's own pages show a named course/module or an explicit programme learning outcome; applied uniformly to all institutions.
tagging.interpretation: Tags are confirmed curriculum presence (a floor), not an exhaustive measure; absence = not confirmed from public sources. Documentation bias is a stated limitation.

provenanceFields.graduatesEstimateBasis: peer group and sample size for imputed graduate figures
provenanceFields.lastChecked: ISO date a record's programme/fee data was last verified against source; null = not yet verified in this provenance system

knownLimitations: 68 institutions are pinned to a city centroid rather than the exact campus (geoSource='nominatim:city').
80 graduatesPerYear values are peer-imputed or unpublished estimates (graduatesEstimated=true); all graduate figures are indicative, not official statistics.
16 Chile cost values are null placeholders: the diploma/programme fee is gated behind an enquiry form and awaits manual entry.

Chile pilot (21 records) sits at verificationLevel 2; programme links were resolvability-checked on 2026-07-22. UNIACC uses an aggregator URL pending an institutional programme page; UCT and Duoc UC point to the continuing-education portal pending a precise programme URL.
Cost figures are current-year rates and will drift; re-verify against source before citing.

validation.method: Stratified random sample (seed=42, region-stratified), each institution checked against its own programme pages under tagging-rubric.md.
validation.censusStatus: In progress (38/309 verified). Sample rate (>50% under-tagged) warrants full verification; CESI campuses corrected via shared national-programme evidence. Priority: <=2-tag population. Records verified under the rubric carry lastChecked. | 2026-07-22: added 21 Chile records (South America pilot), each verified against its own programme page and link-checked; all at verificationLevel 2.
